user.title: Add ZHA Bindings Manager
user.description:
Adds the ZHA Bindings Manager card to Home Assistant, with a ZHA Bindings page in the sidebar (admins only), shared storage so the card's data is the same in every browser, and a notice when you remove a device that others are bound to. There's nothing to fill in; each feature can be switched off later under Configure.

If you installed the ZHA Bindings Manager card from HACS, remove it after adding this: the integration includes the card.

abort.already_configured: ZHA Bindings Manager is already set up. Only one is needed.

init.title: ZHA Bindings Manager options
init.description: Changes apply straight away. Refresh any open browser tabs afterwards.

data.sidebar_panel: Show the ZHA Bindings page in the sidebar
data.load_card_everywhere: Load the card on every page
data.removal_notices: Notify when a removed device still has bindings pointing to it
data.device_page_bindings: Show bindings on each device's page
data.logbook_attribution: Say in the logbook which remote switched a light
data.record_evidence: Record address changes and missed presses
data.reset_lqi: Reset link quality thresholds to recommended (150 and 80)

data_description.sidebar_panel: Admins only. Runs the card full-page. The card's file loads only when you open this page.
data_description.load_card_everywhere: Only needed to put the card on your own dashboards. The card is about 380 KB, and with this on every page loads it, including on phones and tablets that never open it.
data_description.shared_storage: Saves the card's data in Home Assistant, so it's the same in every browser and on every device. When off, each browser keeps its own copy.
data_description.removal_notices: Shows a Home Assistant notification naming the devices still bound to a device you remove, based on the card's last scan.
data_description.device_page_bindings: Adds a Bindings sensor and a Rescan bindings button to the page of each ZHA device that controls, or is controlled by, another device or a group. Uses the card's last scan.
data_description.binding_watch: Compares every read of a device's binding table (the card's scans, a nightly check at 03:17, and battery devices when they're next used) with the bindings it had before, and tells you in the card and in Repairs when one is lost, with a button to put it back. You can choose per device in the card to put them back automatically. Uses the card's scans as the starting point.
data_description.logbook_attribution: When a remote is bound to lights or a group and Home Assistant also hears the press (most remotes are bound to the coordinator too), a light that changes within 3 seconds gets a logbook entry such as "turned on by Kitchen remote (direct binding)". Uses the card's last scan of the remote. Changes made by Home Assistant itself aren't attributed.
data_description.record_evidence: Keeps a history of every device's short network address and notes when a remote's press doesn't reach a light it's bound to directly, so you can see whether address changes explain bindings that stop working. Read-only: nothing is sent to your devices. Shown in the card and exportable.
data_description.experimental_features: Features still being tested; they may change or go away. Currently: a route check for each binding and a network map, both built from the routing and neighbour tables of your routers, read with zha-toolkit only when you ask.
data_description.lqi_good: Links with at least this link quality (LQI, 0-255) count as good. Recommended: 150.
data_description.lqi_weak: Links below this count as weak. Recommended: 80. Must be lower than the good value.
data_description.reset_lqi: Tick and submit to go back to the recommended values.

error.lqi_order: The weak threshold must be lower than the good threshold.

card_installed_twice.title: ZHA Bindings Manager card is installed twice
card_installed_twice.description:
The ZHA Bindings Manager card is also installed from HACS (Lovelace resource `{resource}`). This integration already includes the card, so the two copies compete for the page and the one that runs may be out of date.

Remove **ZHA Bindings Manager** from HACS → Frontend (HACS also removes its Lovelace resource). If you use the card on your own dashboards, first turn on **Load the card on every page** under Settings → Devices & services → ZHA Bindings Manager → Configure.

This notice disappears after the next restart once the HACS card is gone.

confirm.title: Put the lost bindings back

error.not_all: Not all of them went back yet: see below.
